operatorProcedure: Record operator identity, start time, clean checkout SHA, and engine SHA.
Run only read-only local inspection; do not call providers or rerun capture.
Adjudicate all 12 corrected-worklist candidates; locate each by raw selector and confirm exact property identity, URL, rating scale, timestamp, and OSEG scope.
Record promote, reject, or defer plus rationale for every candidate.
For promoted evidence, preserve a short exact excerpt, source URL, rating, date, theme, and consulting limitation.
Run the strengthened verifier and record the unchanged machine blocker set.
Commit only the completed reproduction result; do not export, send, deploy, or change production pins.
completionRule: Reproduction is complete only when a distinct human operator adjudicates all 12 corrected-worklist candidates, reruns verification, and commits the signed result. Packet creation and curated-candidate review alone are insufficient.

correctedWorklist.interpretation: The queue is recency-first. Matching only makes a record a candidate; it does not establish property relevance, OSEG scope, or a client-facing claim.
